usage: 沖涼液 is used as a noun to refer to the liquid soap specifically meant for washing the body in the shower.
It can appear in sentences as the subject or object, for example '我用沖涼液' means 'I use body wash.'
In questions, it can be asked about like '你有冇沖涼液？' meaning 'Do you have body wash?'
It can be combined with words like '瓶' (bottle) to specify quantity, e.g., '一瓶沖涼液' means 'a bottle of body wash.'
沖涼液 is often used in daily conversation about personal hygiene and bathroom items.
